name: Chimera Metastasios
_notes: Transcribed from sheet BU0780 (front Lv I-IV / back Lv V-IX), AI BR0781-BR0801, BP BS0803-BS0822, Routine Terrorize BR0800, Mnestis Routine Snakes and Ladders, Signature Trudge BR0799, Special Attack Three-headed Monstrosity BR0801, Status Absorbed BS0822.
3x3 footprint; rear row = Rear (no Blindspot). Zone patterns: [depth, lateral] from the front edge; the card diagrams are read with the skull facing right (black cells = in front).
OoR evade (Critical Mass) is counted when an Attack target ends up out of range (interpretation).
Ambrosia Trail tile = 3x3, placed centred against one edge of the Chimera.

vp.name: Chimeric Acropolis
vp.text: Climb: Test Fury (8+; Lv V+: 9+). If you are instructed to create a Vantage Point and both VPs are already created, place 1 generic token here instead. Each of these tokens lowers Climb and Hold On test difficulty by 1 (to a minimum of 1). VP Effects: When on a VP, each time you Wound, you deal an additional Single Wound that goes into the Secondary Wound Stack. Hold On: End of Primordial Round, if on VP, test Endurance (6+). Fail: Knockdown. Displace onto a Rear space.

traits.Slime Trail: As the Chimera moves, it leaves behind a trail of black Ambrosia. After the Chimera ends its movement, place an Ambrosia Trail tile directly behind it.
traits.This Train: The Chimera always moves its full Speed value and that movement is considered a Pushback. The Pushback applies to the Target, as well as every Titan adjacent to the Chimera at the start of the move. If the Target is on the VP, the Chimera still moves in the direction it is currently facing. Titanwall: All Titans affected by Pushback can collectively use all effects that mitigate it. Nobody Stops: If the Pushback value is reduced below 3, the Chimera gains a positive Speed token.
traits.Metamorphosis: The Chimera's physical state is indicated by the last wounded BP card. Gelatinous: If attacked with a Weapon other than Club, Cestus, Slabsword or Shield, the Chimera has +1 AT (Level 2+: +2). Supersolid: If attacked with a Club, Cestus, Slabsword or Shield Weapon, +1 AT (Level 4+: +2). Corrosive: After you resolve a successful Attack (at least 1 hit), if your Weapon is not Stone, Relief, Divine, Hephaestum, Cyclopean, Mythic or Electrum, exhaust it and gain Danger equal to Chimera LVL.
traits.The Strong Eat: Additional Setup: Add 1 You died! Obol to the Obol deck.
traits.Critical Mass: Each time the Chimera gains a Wound on the Secondary Wound Stack or you OoR evade, place a generic token on this Trait. If there are 3 or more tokens, finish resolving the current action, discard all tokens, then draw and resolve the top AI card.
traits.Highly Toxic: The Chimera's Ambrosia is highly toxic and volatile. During this Battle, all Titans suffer the following penalty: Level 2-3: Ambrosia Limit -1. Level 4-6: Ambrosia Limit -2. Level 7+: Ambrosia Limit -3.
traits.Digestive Acids: End of Primordial Round: Each Titan gains as many Danger as they have Ambrosia tokens.
traits.Voracious Bog: During the Primordial Round, Ambrosia Pools and Ambrosia Trails have the Chasm keyword. If a Titan ends their turn on an Ambrosia Pool or Ambrosia Trail tile, they die.
traits.End of Hope: End of Primordial Round: Perform Signature.
traits.Black Rain: Start of Titan turn: If you are in front of the Chimera, unless you have an Umbrella Gear card, gain 1 Ambrosia token.
traits.Insatiable Pull: End of Primordial Round: Pull each Titan X spaces, where X is the number of Ambrosia tokens they have. If you are pulled adjacent to the Chimera and the Pull value was not lowered to 0, instead of continuing the Pull you are Absorbed.
traits.Primordial Plasma: If there are no Wound cards in the Wound Stack or the last card is a Single or Double Wound, the Chimera's state is Plasmous: if attacked with a Weapon other than Primordial, Divine, Mythic or Eldertech, the Chimera has +2 AT and you exhaust your Weapon after resolving this Attack.
traits.Living Fortress: You can only Wound the Chimera from a VP or when Absorbed.
traits.Ruthless: Remove all positive Trauma cards from the Trauma decks (except Obols).
traits.Three Point Six: When a Titan becomes adjacent to the Chimera, they gain 1 Ambrosia token. When a Titan is Absorbed, they immediately gain 1 Ambrosia token. When a Titan ends their turn on a VP, they gain 1 Ambrosia token.
traits.Beginning of the End: End of Primordial Round: Before End of Hope, draw and perform another AI card.

status.Absorbed: When you are Absorbed, place your Titan here. As long as you are Absorbed, you cannot move (voluntarily or involuntarily) and you attack as if you were on a VP. Indigestion: If there are any Absorbed Titans, when the Chimera suffers a Secondary Stack Wound, place 1 generic token under each Titan miniature here. Then, if there are 2 or more generic tokens under a miniature, that Titan is regurgitated! Place their miniature on an empty space adjacent to the Chimera. End of Titan Round: Each Absorbed Titan gains 1 Ambrosia token and draws an Obol. Discard all generic tokens under the Absorbed Titans. Zeus Godform has +1 Power when Absorbed. If you are ever Absorbed while being Absorbed, you die. End of Battle: Bellynaut Special Event (campaign).
